description: Register postaj in postajališč is a dataset listed in Slovenia’s open data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by MINISTRSTVO ZA INFRASTRUKTURO IN ENERGETIKO. Intersection of registered railway and bus stations and stops. It includes all active bus and train stations with precise geospatial coordinates. Coverage: MINISTRSTVO ZA INFRASTRUKTURO IN ENERGETIKO. The portal shows the English title as "Register of stations and stops" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is MINISTRSTVO ZA INFRASTRUKTURO IN ENERGETIKO. Its keywords include postaje, postajališča. The listing shows 4 download or service links in PDF, HTML, ZIP. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-odprti-podatki-slovenije.
